description: This file defines the MountInfo struct and functions to parse and retrieve mount information from /proc/self/mountinfo and related files, used for inspecting filesystem mounts on Linux systems.

classes.name: MountInfo
classes.description: Struct representing details of a filesystem mount, including IDs, paths, options, filesystem type, source, and superblock options.

methods.name: parseMountInfo
methods.description: Parses byte data from mountinfo files into a list of MountInfo structs.

methods.name: parseMountInfoString
methods.description: Parses a single line of mountinfo into a MountInfo struct.

methods.name: mountOptionsIsValidField
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid optional field key.

methods.name: mountOptionsParseOptionalFields
methods.description: Parses optional fields into a map from a list of strings.

methods.name: mountOptionsParser
methods.description: Parses mount options and superblock options into a map.

methods.name: GetProcMounts
methods.description: Retrieves mountinfo for a specific process ID.
